correctness.rationale: The 64 received triples split into symbol-equality types AAA (4), ABA (12), AAB/ABB (24), ABC (24). Independent exact arithmetic confirms nonnegative dual masses 1/2,1/8,3/8,1/4 with total 37/2; every one of 256 length-four words has distinct-deletion dual weight at most 1, equivalently all fifteen equality-pattern orbits have maximum 1. This yields integer code size >=ceil(37/2)=19. Independently recomputed full deletion shadows of all nineteen listed words; their union equals all 64 triples. The proposed fractional primal weights 1/6,1/3,1/3,1/12,3/16 on codeword equality patterns 0012,0100,0101,0122,0123 give coverage exactly 1 for each 64 triple and total 37/2. Strong LP duality establishes exact fractional optimum. This is COMPLETE finite exhaustion of the stated 256x64 universe, not a sample or an infinite-family claim.
